findings.summary: Raw state files are written into out/raw/ without clearing earlier runs; test_acceptance's S4 check os.walk()s the whole out/raw and compares its tally to the model's state_totals, so a module removed or unpublished since a previous run leaves stale state.csv files that the new model no longer counts.
findings.effect: After the SDK drops a module, the S4 acceptance check reports a mismatch (or passes against stale data) even though the fresh dashboard is correct.

findings.summary: github.raw is documented to return None on 404, but gradle_texts values and the CODEOWNERS text (line 306) are passed straight to parse_module/Codeowners, which assume str; a None build file or CODEOWNERS crashes with TypeError/AttributeError instead of a clear error (catalogs get an explicit None check at line 327, these do not).
findings.effect: If a build file or CODEOWNERS is missing or moved, the generator dies with an opaque traceback rather than a message naming the missing file.
